text:
Basic Product Management

Did you know that 70% of new products fail because they don’t solve a real problem? Understanding the foundations of a great product can set you apart from the rest.

Objectives

By the end of this module, you’ll be able to:

Define what a product is and what makes it great.

Understand the role and responsibilities of a product manager.

Identify the skills needed to start a career in product management.

Learn from real-world product management examples and case studies.

 

Recall of Prior Knowledge

Think about the last product you purchased and loved. What made it stand out? Was it the design, ease of use, or the problem it solved? Keep that in mind as we dive into product management fundamentals.

 

Content
1. What is a Product & What are the foundations of a good product

These articles discuss the fundamental aspects of a product, including its core function, user experience, and business impact. It also covers the principles of creating a successful product that meets market needs.

What is a product

SVPG - Foundation of Product

2.  What is Product Management?

This article breaks down the role of a product manager, highlighting the skills required, common misconceptions, and how product managers bridge the gap between business strategy and user needs.

So you want to be a product Manager?

3. Product Management Fundamentals

This course provides a structured introduction to product management, covering topics like product lifecycle, stakeholder management, and roadmap planning, along with real-world case studies.

To truly immerse in product management, watch this video: Fundamentals of Product Management
